label: Source support for 87afc0da from I q.80 a.1 co. and ad 3
note: For a natural operation of the kind discussed, the form supplies an intrinsic orientation beyond the fact that an action reached an end. The route needs the relevant form of every OperatesThrough witness, including an apprehended form, to ground its particular InclinedTo. External direction toward an end by itself gives no such inclination in the instrument.
